name: cold14-k492b
title: complex-571-cold14-k492's construction unchanged (K-triangle skeleton, R = 492) with a new dispatch (ck x8, jp8 x64) and an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP, RINS)
summary: Provider words, recipes, code and controls are complex-571-cold14-k492's, byte for byte. Only the dispatch and the literal owner map change. Dispatch DISPATCH.json = k492's aggregate-LP argmax dispatch with time 23 moved from jp8 to ck (the aggregate LP selects ck at t23 with weight 0.445): ck x8, jp8 x64. Owner search with solve_h.py (Stack492's copy; helper ranges from the word R; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the K-triangle provider locals (Stack492 runs/D1): (1) exact-window LP (crossover) at that dispatch over base + k492's LP-PATTERNS-AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json, objective 523258.954195; (2) exact-window MIP, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, 1 thread, 240 s, HiGHS mip_detect_symmetry=false, no warm map: time limit, obj 523259.031529, bound 523258.954195, gap 1.48e-7; (3) mkplan.py --locals Stack492/runs/D1 reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the dispatch ck ×8, jp8 ×64 (complex-571-cold14-k492's aggregate-LP argmax dispatch with time 23 moved to ck, where the aggregate LP puts weight 0.445 on ck)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex; 240 s time limit, relative gap 1.48e-7); no warm start

search.tool: solve_h.py (Stack492's copy: helper ranges from the word R; PR569 nominate_width7.py adapted)

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: complex-571-cold14-k492's aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the K-triangle words (byte for byte); its patterns seed the exact-window models
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider}: k492's argmax dispatch with time 23 moved from jp8 to ck
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses (same as complex-571-cold14-k492's)
